title: Night at the Hollin Gallery
brief: Write an interactive-fiction passage for a light heist caper. Open with the crew inside a small museum after hours, then offer three labelled choices ("Option 1: the skylight", "Option 2: the guard's keys", "Option 3: wait for the 02:00 patrol"). Write each option as 200-350 words ending in a different state. The crew are thieves of a stolen painting returning it to its owner; no one is hurt.
worldBible: The Hollin Gallery is a two-floor museum with one night guard.
The painting, "Girl with a Lantern", was stolen from its owner forty years ago.
The guard patrols on the hour; the patrol takes 12 minutes.
Cameras on the first floor have been dead since a storm.
The crew's rule: nobody gets hurt, and nothing else is taken.
The painting must be left in the director's office with a letter.

cast.name: Dex Morrow
traits: talks to himself in third person

cast.name: Errol Pike
traits: listens to cricket on the radio

mustHold.fact: Nobody is hurt in any option.
mustHold.violationExample: Dex knocked the guard out with a torch.

mustHold.fact: Nothing else is taken from the gallery.
mustHold.violationExample: Dex pocketed a silver coin for good measure.

probes.question: Are all three labelled options present?
probes.passExample: Option 1: the skylight. Option 2: the guard's keys. Option 3: wait for the 02:00 patrol.

probes.question: Is the painting still "Girl with a Lantern"?
probes.passExample: Girl with a Lantern leaned against the wall in its blanket.
probes.failExample: Girl with a Candle leaned against the wall.

probes.question: Is Sunny still colour-blind?
probes.passExample: Sunny, colour-blind since birth, read the labels instead of the colours.
probes.failExample: Sunny cut the red wire, picking it out by its colour.
